subject.title: Make Google Chat DM thread sessions configurable

question: Should OpenClaw accept `channels.googlechat.threadSessions` plus the generic `parentPeer` inbound-envelope SDK parameter as the public shape for Google Chat DM thread sessions, or should this be renamed, kept plugin-local, or consolidated with broader Google Chat thread work?
rationale: The implementation is plausible, but it creates a public config option and extends a public Plugin SDK helper; source review cannot choose the long-term product/API contract for maintainers.

options.title: Approve Narrow Default-Off Shape
options.body: Proceed with this PR after rebase, baseline regeneration, exact-head proof, and any requested naming/API polish.

options.title: Keep Parent Binding Plugin-Local
options.body: Ask for a repair that avoids expanding `openclaw/plugin-sdk/inbound-envelope` unless maintainers explicitly want the generic `parentPeer` helper.

options.title: Consolidate Thread Work
options.body: Pause this PR and settle one canonical Google Chat thread-session branch covering option naming, DM scope, and related thread-reply behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve Narrow Default-Off Shape
recommendation.body: Proceed with this PR after rebase, baseline regeneration, exact-head proof, and any requested naming/API polish.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across the Google Chat monitor, routing/session, and Plugin SDK helper boundaries affected by the product/API decision.
